project: GPS Triangle — Bill Maisey performance analysis & coaching report
note: Master feature + testing backlog. TDD applies to the build: for each feature, write a failing test (red), implement to green, then flip passes=true and commit test+impl+spec together. Data/analysis features are validated by reconciliation tests (computed values match the authoritative rcmodelspot results and API distance fields). Scaffold captured 2026-09-27 ahead of build; refine before building.

features.description: Fetch competition standings and heat/group tree for the Oschatz 2026 event from the rcmodelspot JSON API
steps: GET /CompetitionGpsTriangle/Results/{guid} and cache raw JSON
Parse standings (38 pilots) and heats -> groups -> per-flight results
Test: Bill's 17 flights are present and his total (12562) and rank (22) reconcile to the standings

features.description: Fetch per-group ~1Hz GPS replay tracks and select Bill plus the same-air group leader per round
steps: For each of Bill's 17 groups, GET /CompetitionGpsTriangle/ReplayGroup/{groupId}
Identify the scoring flight (handle multi-start artefacts) and the top-scoring same-group leader
Test: Bill and leader present in all 17 groups; parsed laps/speed reconcile to the results tree

features.description: Enrich each flight with weather from the Open-Meteo ERA5 archive at the Oschatz coordinates
steps: GET ERA5 hourly (wind, temp, cloud, radiation, cape) for 3-8 Aug 2026, Europe/Berlin
Map each flight's group start time to the nearest hour
Test: every flight has a weather row within the event window; wind cross-checks track drift order-of-magnitude

features.description: Per-round metric bundle (laps, avg speed, entry altitude/speed, energy, thermalling, pacing, line efficiency) for Bill vs same-air leader
steps: Compute metrics from tracks; convert units (groundSpeed km/h, vario, haversine distances)
Test: computed laps and avg speed equal the authoritative results for every flight; distances within ~3% of API distance fields

features.description: Flight-phase decomposition (start / straight / turn / climb) with per-lap time-deficit attribution vs leader
steps: Segment tracks by bearing-rate and vario; separate turnpoint turns from thermal circles by duration/continuity
Attribute per-lap deficit across phases; rank phases by cost to Bill
Test: phase times per flight sum to the motor-off flight duration (within tolerance); speedrun rounds excluded

features.description: Condition-dependence analysis: Bill's within-group (conditions-controlled) score vs wind and thermal-strength proxies, and time-of-day
steps: Join weather to per-flight scores; compute associations with n caveat
Test: correlations computed over the 14 distance rounds; reported as suggestive, not significant

features.description: Week-long progression separating skill (within-group normalised score) from conditions (raw laps)
steps: Order rounds by day/time; trend normalised score and raw laps
Test: rounds ordered chronologically; both series present for all distance rounds

features.description: Single self-contained HTML file, emailable and openable offline, with all data and charts embedded
steps: Generate report/bill_oschatz_2026.html with inline SVG charts and embedded per-round data
Test: no remote script/image/style dependencies required to render; file opens standalone; size reasonable

features.description: Four-page app in one file with a top nav bar: title text left ('Bill's GPS Triangle Analysis 2026', no emoji/logo), right-aligned always-visible links Home/Analysis/Recommendations/Innovations that collapse to a burger menu on mobile; JS toggles the visible page. The Analysis page carries the Overview/Rounds dropdown (Overview default + 17 rounds)
steps: Build top-bar nav, page-routing JS, mobile burger, and the Analysis Overview/Rounds dropdown
Test: 4 nav links present and right-aligned; Home shown on load; each link shows only its page; burger appears at mobile width; Analysis dropdown has 18 options (Overview + 17 rounds)

features.description: Home page: very concise project summary plus the three sections listed as linked headings (Performance Analysis, Recommendations, Innovations); no deep content
steps: Author a short summary and three linked section headings that route to the pages
Test: Home holds a summary paragraph and exactly three section links that navigate to Analysis/Recommendations/Innovations

features.description: Overview content: result, strengths/weaknesses verdict, phase levers ranked, conditions, progression, consistency, prioritised recommendations
steps: Author sections in Point-Evidence-Explain form
Test: each Overview insight has an evidence figure/number and an explain/recommendation; no flagged lexical tics present

features.description: Per-round views: energy/altitude trace, ground-track overlay, cumulative laps vs leader, biggest-loss segment, metrics strip (incl. weather), recommendation
steps: Render each round from the embeddable dataset
Test: all 17 rounds render their charts and a captioned figure each; speedruns labelled distinctly

features.description: Recommendations shown inline in Analysis next to their motivating evidence AND consolidated on the Recommendations page organised into implementation themes; one canonical set surfaced in both places via shared anchors, each linking back to its Analysis evidence and out to relevant Innovations
steps: Author recommendations with stable anchor ids; render inline in Analysis and grouped by theme on the Recommendations page

Test: every top-level weakness has at least one drill and one further-analysis suggestion; each recommendation appears inline in Analysis and on the themed Recommendations page under the same anchor; back-links to Analysis evidence resolve

features.description: Innovations page (art-of-the-possible coaching technology): standalone and rules-grounded (navigator telemetry/AR, audio vario, live AI cueing, data flywheel), with each point anchored so Analysis and Recommendations can link to it in context
steps: Author forward-looking tiers with legality framing from Sport-class regs (no data into model control; navigator AR at CD discretion; pilot HUD training-only); give each point an anchor id
Test: Innovations is its own page, tonally separated from findings; legality claims cite the rules basis; anchor links from Analysis/Recommendations resolve to the right point

features.description: In-page summary + collapsible sections on every page (Overview and each round): opening summary (few sentences + ~5 bullets of key points/recommendations) with bullets anchor-linking to sections; section headers link back to top; sections collapsible with Expand all / Collapse all controls
steps: Add per-page summary block, anchor links, back-to-top links, collapse/expand JS and controls
Test: each page has a summary with ~5 bullets that anchor to on-page section ids; each section header links to top; Expand all/Collapse all toggle every section; summary stays visible

features.description: Every claim is grounded: backed by an on-page plot/visualisation and/or a link to the source data online (rcmodelspot event/flight pages; weather source; Sport-class regs). Recommended tech/drills link to a relevant online resource only where genuinely useful — no forced links
steps: Attach a figure reference and/or source-data link to each claim; add resource links to recommendations where relevant
Test: no claim lacks either an on-page figure or a source link; every external link resolves and is topically relevant; recommendations without a useful source carry no link

features.description: Design system: white background, Deloitte-inspired palette with no Deloitte branding, elegant typeface, no AI-tell styling (no accent bars/stripes, gradients), no emojis anywhere, all figures captioned
steps: Define palette tokens and typography; render charts on the shared palette
Test: background white; no 'deloitte' string/logo; no left/top accent-bar pattern; no emoji characters anywhere in the output; every <figure> has a <figcaption>

features.description: Methodology page (added after the four-page product is accepted): visual narrative of the human+agent build. Top summary paragraph + collapsed-by-default setup panel (Claude Code; CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md intent-capture heuristics; laptop with Python). Work grouped into high-level steps (Specify/Research/Design/Build/Refinement/Review/Finish); each step expandable from an ask-summary to the verbatim user prompts + a summary of what the agent/subagents did; durations shown at each level (agent working-time exact from harness metadata; user clarifications marked). Adds Methodology to the nav (5th page)
steps: Assemble from docs/METHODOLOGY_LOG.md; render steps as expandable sections with durations; add nav link
Test: Methodology page present and in nav; setup panel collapsed by default; each step expands to verbatim prompts + agent-action summary; durations rendered; no emojis

features.description: Build-review includes a Playwright (CLI) visual/UI pass: render the file, screenshot pages at desktop and mobile widths, verify layout, charts visible, nav/burger, collapsibles, cross-page links, and no overflow, before the user reviews
steps: A review subagent drives Playwright to load report/*.html and capture/inspect each page at >=2 viewports
Test: screenshots captured for all pages at desktop + mobile; no horizontal overflow; charts render; nav, burger, and collapsibles operate; findings written to reviews/

features.description: GPS ground-track chart correctness + orientation aids: fix the reference-triangle geometry so it sits correctly over the flown course (right position/scale/rotation), render it bold and LAST so it is on top of the traces; add a North arrow (N + arrowhead) in the top-right; render full-resolution traces (remove downsampling); dark grey/off-black for the orientation marks
steps: Debug turnpoint reconstruction from start point + course axis + leg length (correct geodesic offset and equirectangular projection with cos(lat) scaling); draw triangle last, bold; add North arrow; use full tracks
Test: reference triangle vertices lie within the flown-track bounding envelope; triangle drawn after traces; North marker present; traces use full resolution

features.description: Per-plot wind annotation: on each GPS-trace plot show a wind vector arrow positioned at the clockface location of the wind source bearing, OUTSIDE the trace box, pointing inward (the direction the wind blows), with a compass+degrees label (e.g. WNW 285) and speed in KNOTS beneath; small but legible; dark grey/off-black
steps: Pass per-round wind (dir/speed) to the ground-track chart; place arrow+label at the bearing's clockface position outside the plot; convert km/h to knots; compute the compass point from the bearing
Test: each ground-track plot renders a wind arrow at the correct clockface position with a knots label; northerly does not collide with the North marker

features.description: Time axes use RUN-RELATIVE time (T0 = start-line crossing) for like-for-like overlays, fixing the speed-run altitude showing absolute clock (pilots offset by ~25 min); audit all time-based charts for the same issue
steps: Normalise each pilot's time series to its start-line crossing for the speed-run overlays; review triangle-round time charts and align to a sensible zero
Test: speed-run altitude traces both start at t=0 (run time); no chart shows large empty offsets from absolute wall-clock

features.description: Collapsible section control shows a dynamic label: 'Expand' when collapsed, 'Collapse' when expanded (replaces the static 'toggle'), updating on state change
steps: Update the collapsible control markup + JS to reflect state
Test: control reads 'Expand' when a section is collapsed and 'Collapse' when expanded; no 'toggle' label remains

features.description: Rename the 'Legality gate' label to 'Legality Consideration' in Innovations and any other section using it; style it as bold inline emphasis at body-text size (a highlighted lead-in, not a large sub-header)
steps: Replace the label text and render it as bold inline emphasis at body size
Test: no 'Legality gate' or 'Legality Gate' string remains; the replacement reads 'Legality Consideration' as bold body-size text, not a heading element

features.description: Hyperlink references to the rules/regs throughout the report (e.g. 'regs section 2.7', 'Sport-class regs') to the regulations source: section-specific mentions to the Sport-class regs PDF, general mentions to the regulations index
steps: Find regs references across all pages and wrap them in links to gps-triangle.net regulations (PDF for section-specific, index for general)
Test: regs references render as links to a gps-triangle.net regulations URL; no bare 'regs section N' text remains unlinked

features.description: Retitle to 'GPS Triangle World Masters, Oschatz 2026' in the nav header bar and the Home page h1 (replacing 'Bill's GPS Triangle Analysis 2026'); Home content makes clear the focus is Bill Maisey. Rename the output HTML file and the GitHub repo to match (gps-triangle-world-masters-oschatz-2026)
steps: Update TITLE_TEXT and Home h1; rename report output file; update tests/build refs; rename the repo via gh and update the remote
Test: nav title and Home h1 read 'GPS Triangle World Masters, Oschatz 2026'; Home text names Bill Maisey; output file renamed; no 'Bill's GPS Triangle Analysis 2026' remains

features.description: Repo README.md written after the product is finished, styled after the user's bloaty-mcbloatface project: fairly thorough taster covering objective, visual storytelling, what was built, key insights, design, and recommendations — not exhaustive
steps: Read the bloaty-mcbloatface README to match its voice/structure
Write README covering objective, visual story, what was built, key insights, design, recommendations
Test: README present with those sections, embeds/links representative visuals, and reads as a taster not an exhaustive dump
